resources.string: This PDF can\'t be read. If it needs a password, unlock it first.
The size is worked out from the first page; pages with photos come out larger.
Marked: the fields and comments on page 1 that become part of the page.

Form answers, comments, highlights and stamps that have their own look are drawn into the pages, so they can no longer be edited as fields or comments. The answers stay readable, selectable text, and anyone with a PDF editor can still change page content. Links, and comments without a look of their own, are kept as they are. Nothing is hidden: use Redact to remove words.

The frame shows what auto trim keeps of page 1; every page gets its own frame.
Cropping hides the cut-away parts but does not delete them, so anyone can undo it. To remove something for good, use Redact.
